craft_notes: Sthāyin: frame vow (FIRST-VERSE voice: plain declaration, no ornament; sets the house voice — owner verdict required before treating as voice). Sanskrit: deho devālayaḥ proktaḥ...so'haṃ bhāvena pūjayet → L4 drops 'The/is' articles for chant-weight, keeps called/sweep/worship. Rows: row 2 (sweep→worship). Close: feeling (bhāva end-weighted as the practice). Rejected: 'proclaimed' (L2's verb) — killed: called kept (blunter, singable); softening so'ham — killed: I-am-He kept (the formula IS the verse).

lines: Body called God's temple, self God everlasting:
sweep off ignorance — worship in I-am-He feeling.
l4.sanskrit_cite: deho devālayaḥ proktaḥ svātmā devaḥ sanātanaḥ | tyajedajñānanirmālyaṃ so'haṃ bhāvena pūjayet

reads_against.argmap: What is declared? → The frame vow: body as temple, self as god, worship as so'ham-feeling after casting ignorance.
c1_essence: Body declared god's temple, self the eternal god: worship with I-am-He feeling after casting ignorance.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
